description: This script automates performance testing for Git clone operations, specifically measuring the speed of cloning with a reference repository. It sets up repositories, modifies content, and runs performance tests to evaluate cloning behavior.

methods.name: test_perf_default_repo
methods.description: Initializes or sets up the default repository for performance testing.

methods.name: test_expect_success
methods.description: Defines test steps that are expected to succeed; executes a command sequence and verifies success.

methods.name: test_perf
methods.description: Runs performance tests given a description and command sequence.

methods.name: test_done
methods.description: Marks the completion of the test script.
